whatIsIt.eli5: Each spot asks every other spot 'are you useful to me?' and collects notes from the useful ones.
whatIsIt.simple: Multi-head self-attention on a feature map: each position makes a query, a key and a value; the query–key similarity decides how much of each value to take.
whatIsIt.engineer: qkv = Conv1×1(dim → dim + 2·nh·key_dim); attn = softmax(qᵀk·key_dim^−½); out = v·attnᵀ + PE(v) (3×3 depthwise); proj Conv1×1.

whyExists.eli5: Some clues are far away in the picture.
whyExists.simple: It gives every position a view of the whole map, not just its neighbours.
whyExists.engineer: Global receptive field in one layer.

eli5: Each spot writes a question and a label.
Questions are matched with labels everywhere.
Each spot gathers notes from good matches.
simple: A 1×1 Conv makes queries, keys and values (split into heads).
Scores = queries × keys for every pair of positions.
Weights × values = mixed features; a 3×3 depthwise conv on the values adds position information.
A final 1×1 Conv mixes the heads.
engineer: key_dim = (dim/heads)·attn_ratio; scores are N×N per head.
Counted by thop via functional matmul ops.
